name: Koumigami ~Nageki Warau Hebigami, Imouto Naru Monomono ga Tsumugishi Folklore~
original_name: コウミガミ～嘆き嗤う蛇神、妹なる者々が紡ぎし口碑～
source: There exists an island with a Shrine, where a Snake God is worshiped. The deity demands that the siblings of the Shrine marry each other, and, if the precept is broken, a curse supposedly will fall upon the family. Protagonist's father did not follow this custom and married a woman, who was not related to him by blood. He fathered a son (the protagonist) and a daughter. After their father dies, their mother begins to act weird, while a mysterious man shows up on the island, asking about the old family custom and the curse....
translation: 一座岛上有一间供奉蛇神的神社。神明要求神社家族中的兄妹彼此通婚，据说一旦违背这项戒律，家族就会遭到诅咒。主人公的父亲没有遵循这一习俗，而是娶了一名与自己没有血缘关系的女子，生下一个儿子（主人公）和一个女儿。父亲死后，母亲开始举止异常；与此同时，一个神秘男人来到岛上，打听这个家族古老的习俗与诅咒……
